name: Online Video Interview
description: Interviews conducted remotely via video conferencing platforms (e.g., Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams).

name: On-Site / In-Person Interview
description: Face-to-face evaluation conducted directly at the company's corporate office or physical business location.

name: Telephonic Screening
description: Initial voice-only audio call to assess candidate baseline qualifications, communication skills, and compensation fit.

name: Technical Assessment / Coding Test
description: Proctored or unproctored skills assessment, coding challenge, or practical assignment completed via online evaluation portals.

name: Group Discussion / Panel Interview
description: Simultaneous evaluation of multiple candidates or assessment by a cross-functional board of internal stakeholders.

name: Human Resources / Behavioral Round
description: Evaluation focusing on cultural alignment, core values, interpersonal soft skills, and reference checks.
